get_channels_status: get the status of all IM channels via the channels gateway router
restart_channel: restart a specific IM channel by name using the channels gateway router
build_ChannelStatusResponse: build a pydantic response model with service_running and channels fields for channel status
build_ChannelRestartResponse: build a pydantic response model with success and message fields for channel restart results
test_channels_router: test the channels gateway router endpoints for status and restart functionality
